githubAbout:
I'm a **Lead Backend Engineer** focused on production APIs and applied AI systems, bringing RAG pipelines and multi-agent workflows from prototype to stable production.

I bridge high-throughput backend architecture and intelligent LLM orchestration: production APIs, data pipelines, vector database integration, caching, auth, and agent lifecycle management.

Currently at **Keyrium Consulting**, I lead backend development for high-concurrency enterprise APIs (Loyalty Rewards & Stock Trading) using **Node.js**, **TypeScript**, and **PostgreSQL**, including system design, CI/CD automation, cloud deployment, and testing (85% code coverage).

**Focus areas:** Scalable distributed architectures · LLM orchestration · RAG pipelines · Multi-agent workflows · Cloud & API optimization

**Stack:** Node.js · TypeScript · Python · PostgreSQL · AWS · RAG · LLMs

**Let's connect:** [okeowoemmanuelm@gmail.com](mailto:okeowoemmanuelm@gmail.com) · [Portfolio](https://epicnode.hostless.site) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/okeowoemmanuelm/)
